$comment: Non-npm components shipped in the bundle: WASM builds and native binaries. docs/LICENSE-POLICY.md §2. `licence` must be an SPDX expression — scripts/check-licenses.mjs validates it against the allow-list. Keep in sync with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt at release. Components with "shipped": false are kept for the record but left out of THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, since we do not distribute them.

components.name: PDFium
components.notes: Precompiled wasm. We do not build it ourselves yet; before shipping a paid edition, either reproduce the build or pin and archive the artefact.

components.name: pdf.js wasm helpers (OpenJPEG, qcms)
components.notes: NOT SHIPPED: pdfjs-dist is a devDependency used by the engine benchmark and as a second opinion when a document renders oddly. Re-add to the notices if the pdf.js adapter is ever bundled.

components.name: qpdf
components.licenceFile: notices/qpdf-LICENSE.txt (fetched upstream; the npm package ships none)
components.notes: Precompiled wasm. The package ships no upstream licence text, so THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt must carry Apache-2.0 for qpdf. Repair, encryption and recompression; see ADR 0003.

components.name: libjpeg-turbo
components.notes: IJG is not otherwise on the allow-list; ADR 0003 proposes allowing it for bundled binaries. Permissive, attribution only.

components.name: zlib
components.version: linked into both the qpdf and PDFium wasm builds
components.notes: Flate compression. Already on the allow-list.

components.name: Tesseract (via tesseract.js-core)
components.notes: OCR engine compiled to wasm. Defaults its worker, core and language data to jsDelivr; packages/ocr requires same-origin URLs for all three. See ADR 0004.

components.name: Tesseract language data (tessdata_fast)
components.version: eng, mal, hin as fetched by scripts/fetch-tessdata.mjs
components.distributedVia: not committed; fetched into vendor/tessdata (git-ignored). A release must self-host these or offer them as an opt-in download from our own host (docs/PRIVACY.md)
components.notes: Measured sizes: eng 3.9 MB, mal 5.0 MB, hin 1.1 MB — 10.0 MB for the three, too much to bundle for every user.
